description: THE proven remaining root of the f98 convergence epic. The ActivationKey doubles as both (a) the CONVERGENCE identity (which must COLLAPSE recursive non-dispatch inputs to a bounded class for finiteness — fz-y6w) and (b) the transport LAYOUT identity (which must stay DISTINCT per physical layout — transport shape-meet, transport.rs:338, interns one ShapeId per layout). These pull opposite ways. PROVEN (agent a4a5531, escape-clause): the correct convergence collapse of an emptiness-only list union ([int] | [] -> list(any), ~25 LoC: descr.rs is_pure_list_modulo_empty + convergence_collapse_ty Ignore-key fold) makes partition/4 converge to 1 (fz-f98.14.7.2.2) IN ISOLATION, but the identical collapse on the identical shape via the identical path in 00420 reconnects layout-distinct ValueId positions -> transport.rs:338 panics on 4 distinct interned ShapeIds in one component -> reds 3 transport guards. No type/code-path dimension distinguishes the two; the collapse IS correct, the break is that collapsing the KEY collapses the LAYOUT-IDENTITY. FIX: derive transport layout-identity SEPARATELY from the (collapsed) convergence key — addressed-arrow / [[shapeid_is_pure_layout]] applied to the activation key. UNBLOCKS fz-f98.14.7.2.2 (partition->1; the ~25-LoC keying fix lands the moment this is done) AND fz-f98.14.1 (the seal: a membership-stable wake signal needs the same split). Investigate-and-design first (correct-by-construction; this is the deliberately-fenced-off activation-key model).
title: Separate activation-key convergence-identity from transport-layout-identity
